newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe Pacific Gold 97 production forecast.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe Pacific Gold 97 production forecast.

text.p: Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp said on Tuesday that it estimates production for 1997 to be over one million ounces of gold at an average cash cost of $235 to $255 per ounce.
The company said it expects cash costs overall to be generally higher in 1997 as a result of processing a greater percentage of refractory ore.
Santa Fe projected its Twin Creeks mine would produce 460,000 to 470,000 ounces of gold at an average cash cost of $250 to $260 per ounce in 1997.
It said the Lone Tree Complex is expected to produce 380,000 to 390,000 ounces of gold at a cash cost of $245 to $255 per ounce.
Mesquite is expected to produce 165,000 to 175,000 ounces at a cash cost of $225 to $235 per ounce.
The company said it anticipates its share of 1997 production at the Rosebud mine to be 40,000 to 50,000 ounces at a cash cost of $170 to $180 per ounce.
Gold production in 1996 was 851,619 ounces at an average cash cost of $215 per ounce.
